observations: Two white game consoles stacked on top of each other.
The top console has a 'SONY' logo on the front panel.
Two red boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' are visible.
A black power cable and a black HDMI cable are present.
The image contains a watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL'.

claims.evidence: The console is visible in photo 0, but the model name 'Pro' is not legible on the front.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number on the rear of the console.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into the PSN dashboard.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware fault or be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and running a game.

risks.proof: A photo of the serial numbers on the back of the controllers.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the model number on the back of the console.
Video of the console powered on and connected to the internet.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
